title: Collatz High Cycles Do Not Exist
notes: Discrete Mathematics 349 (2026) 114812; preprint hal-04261183, dated 23 September 2023, submitted 26 October 2023. READ 20 September 2026 from the full text supplied by Philippe; the publisher is blocked by this environment's egress policy. RESULT. Among the (k,x) rational cycles, let S be the set of least members; the CIRCUIT holds the least element of S and the HIGH CYCLE the greatest. Steiner 1977 excludes integer circuits, whose word is 1^x 0^(k-x) with f = (3^x - 2^x)/(2^k - 3^x), using Baker-derived lower bounds on 2^k - 3^x (Ellison). Knight excludes integer HIGH cycles with NO deep bounds. The high-cycle word is the upper Christoffel word v_h with 1s at d_i = floor(k i / x). By Cohn 1972 its reverse is a rotation of it, so f(v_h) and f(v_h^R) lie in one cycle; by Berstel et al, for aperiodic v_h, v_h = 1 u 0 and v_h^R = 0 u 1, whence f(v_h) = (2g(u) + 3^(x-1))/(2^k - 3^x) and f(v_h^R) = (6g(u) + 2^(k-1))/(2^k - 3^x). If both were integers so would be 3 f(v_h) - f(v_h^R) + 1 = 2^(k-1)/(2^k - 3^x), impossible since the gap is odd. IDENTIFICATIONS WITH THIS LABORATORY, verified numerically. (a) Bohm-Sontacchi (2.1) is the laboratory's cycle equation: Knight's g(v) = evenCharge(w) - (2^k - 3^x) on every word of length <= 14, his f(v) being the cycle member where the lab's identity gives x + 1. (b) His v_h is LITERALLY the ceiling mechanical word of J-cycle-cubic-band-order -- identical strings for every coprime (L,o) with L <= 18 -- so the word that a height-bounded Juggler cycle must have (M < m^3, gcd(L,o) = 1) is exactly Knight's high-cycle word. (c) His Theorem 4.6, f(v_h) maximal at k = ceil(x log2 3), is the laboratory's leftover / near-convergent structure. (d) His Remark 4.8, f(v_h) < 1e13 for x < 1e7 forcing more than ten million odd terms, is the same species as the finance mirror's reproduction of Eliahou and Hercher, and halbeisen-hungerbuehler-1997-collatz-cycles Theorem 4.9's two-sided bound 3^x(x/20) < f(v_h)(2^k - 3^x) < 3^x(7x/10), improvable to (x/6, x/2), has the same shape as neg_cycle_finance on the other sign; whether the constants are comparable is NOT claimed and should be checked before anyone says so. THE NEW OBSERVATION IS RECORDED SEPARATELY as J-knight-is-sign-free-and-catalan-bounds-the-escapes: his contradiction uses only that v_h^R is a rotation of v_h, the 1u0 / 0u1 split, and the gap being odd with |gap| > 1 -- never the gap's SIGN -- so it mirrors to the expanding side.
